State  ------- Appellant

full_judgment: 19. But we want to assess the judgment as the Judge convicted a woman. It appears from the statement under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of the accused that she was a young girl of 20 when the offence was committed, although it is clearly seen that her age has been mentioned as 24 and that too by interpolation. Whatever the case may be, whether it is 20 or 24, but the age of the accused is said to be the beginning of her career, and there are suggestions that she is insane, such a woman has been sentenced to death, although the Judge has an option to award a lesser sentence i.e. a sentence of imprisonment for life. Judges are sitting for doing justice, not for passing sentence of death. Death sentence is a sentence which should be passed when the offence committed has not been compatible with any other sentence. Sentence is the judicial determination of a punishment to be inflicted on the facts of the given case. A Judge is sitting for doing justice a Judge is not a butcher who sits only to hang the accused. Even a condemned prisoner has the right to know why he or she was sent to the gallows or why he/she is to die. This judgment can be thrown out on this ground also.
